services.name: Newport Beach Scenic Air Tour
services.desc: 25 Minutes in the sky About Soar over three of Orange County’s prominent beach cities in a private airplane! The Newport Beach Scenic Air Tour is the easiest way to fly in OC. Enjoy a personalized private experience and all-smiles Joy Air service for up to 3 passengers. A great option if you are looking for a quick adventure or a unique date idea that won't break the bank. Highlights This airplane ride features spectacular views of Fashion Island, Pelican Hill, Laguna Beach, Crystal Cove, Balboa Island, Newport Harbor, Huntington Pier and of course... John Wayne Airport! Entire Quick Escape • 25 Minutes • Up to 3 People • All Ages

services.name: OC Coastal Highlights Air Tour
services.desc: Fly over all of Orange County's captivating beaches and coastal cities for 45 minutes. From the southern shores of San Clemente to Huntington Beach! The OC Coastal Classics Air Tour is our most popular scenic flight and the best value airplane ride in OC. Enjoy a personalized private experience and all-smiles Joy Air service for up to 3 passengers. A top choice for both locals and visitors looking for an extended aerial adventure. 45 Minutes in the sky! Scenic Highlights This flight features spectacular views of Newport Harbor, Balboa Island, Pelican Hill Resort, Corona del Most Popular • 45 Minutes • Up to 3 People • All Ages

services.name: OC Deluxe & Disneyland Air Tour
services.desc: The Best of Orange County from the sky...60 minutes of panoramic views and 50 miles of coastline! The Deluxe Coastal Tour features all the highlights from our popular Orange County Coastal Tour... PLUS additional views over downtown Long Beach and Anaheim. Maximize your flight experience with a behind the scenes look at world famous sites like the Port of Los Angeles and Disneyland. Fly over all of Orange County's captivating beaches and coastal cities with all-smiles Joy Air service for up to 3 passengers. Highlights Enjoy aerial views of Newport Harbor, Balboa Island, Pelican Hill Epic Adventure • 60 Minute Flight • Up to 3 People • All Ages Welcome
